Subject: one Assamese adult female Bihu nasoni, about 25 years old, average height, slim healthy dancer build, natural warm medium-brown skin, black hair tied into a neat bun with pink-white kopou foxtail orchids and a slim bamboo hair ornament as in reference. Preserve visible textile separation and the exact reference's Assamese silhouette, not a pleated sari, lehenga or generic Bollywood costume. Restrained gold necklace with small pendant and red beads, small matching earrings, broad simple silver-toned bangles matching reference, barefoot. Panels in reading order: FRONT standing relaxed, THREE-QUARTER standing, SIDE standing, BACK revealing bun and actual cloth drape, BIHU POSE with hands at waist and elbows outward, WITH JAAPI in a graceful relaxed pose holding a decorated Assamese fulam jaapi similar to the reference. Jaapi only in last panel: round woven bamboo/palm hat with red rim, small conical center and restrained black-red decorative sectors, full hat visible. All four standing views have relaxed hands so garment construction is visible. One face identity, one outfit throughout; no extra limbs, duplicated bracelets, floating hair flowers, heels or modern jewelry.
